payload.claim: The criterion requires 'Each bound drives each side once. A wall cut then a turn-ceiling cut, a turn-ceiling cut then a budget-cap cut, and a budget-cap cut then a wall cut' — i.e. three crossed pairs. The witness instead loops over `bounds.items()` and calls the *same* `make_cut` for both the first cut (line 2965) and the second cut (line 2974) in each iteration, producing (wall, wall), (turn-ceiling, turn-ceiling) and (budget-cap, budget-cap) — never the crossed pairs the criterion names.
